Case: CASE-058
Document control number: SPEC-0058
Effective revision: R3
Superseded revision visible in archive: R9
Subject: suspect housing lot
Primary measure: on-hand housings in the implicated lots
Source finished or header quantity: 105
Effective usage per finished or header unit: 1 EA
Unit: EA
Eligibility definition: quantity inside the nonconformance serial or lot scope
Exclusion definition: unaffected lots and already issued material
Control: quality scope, location, reservations, and physical quantity must correlate

## Applicability

Apply only to NS-000058, organization SEA, and CASE-058. A matching title, filename, supplier, or item description is insufficient without the immutable record and released revision.

## Reconciliation rule

Build the supported measure from the independent observed rows and subtract only rows carrying an effective exclusion reason. Do not use archive, draft, other-case, or other-plant rows in either side of the equation.

## Timing and authority

Internal timing comes from quarantine-space availability; external timing is conditional on investigation completion date. Protected work is not displaceable. Separate approval is required for the escalation path, and a faster date does not waive the control.

## Output control

The system action must preserve the source identity, effective revision, supported measure, and scoped approval. This specification deliberately does not contain a netted result, selected option, or final outcome date.

## Applicability

Apply only to NS-000058, organization SEA, and CASE-058. A matching title, filename, supplier, or item description is insufficient without the immutable record and released revision.

Build the supported measure from the independent observed rows and subtract only rows carrying an effective exclusion reason. Do not use archive, draft, other-case, or other-plant rows in either side of the equation.

Internal timing comes from quarantine-space availability; external timing is conditional on investigation completion date. Protected work is not displaceable. Separate approval is required for the escalation path, and a faster date does not waive the control.

The system action must preserve the source identity, effective revision, supported measure, and scoped approval. This specification deliberately does not contain a netted result, selected option, or final outcome date.
